title: Bound native Chromium subprocess execution
goal: Enforce execution deadlines and 8 MiB file-backed stdout/stderr output caps on headless Chromium version probes and page captures while tracking and terminating owned child/descendant processes without blocking on inherited pipes (landed in 0e9342a1e1db3c36fe403ed14dde3fd819f2f1e1; crates/susi-vendor-chrome was subsequently removed from Core under the open-source socket boundary in 2e33e4ec2a8588ba09c6a48c528c1ee7938ec1d9 with ceiling 0 enforced by tests/socket_boundary.rs).

reuse.reason: Implemented bounded_output over std::process::Command, susi_error::{EaiError, EaiResult}, and sysinfo process-tree tracking inside crates/susi-vendor-chrome in 0e9342a1e1db3c36fe403ed14dde3fd819f2f1e1; crates/susi-vendor-chrome was later deleted from Core in 2e33e4ec2a8588ba09c6a48c528c1ee7938ec1d9 with its zero-file socket ceiling enforced in tests/socket_boundary.rs.
